correctness.rationale: Reconstructed definitions and signed fixed-face Lefschetz formula. A deterministic matching-extension subset transfer enumerates the fixed eligible faces exactly; 24 reachable strip states and 112 weighted transitions give exact integer Cayley-Hamilton recurrence certificate at all 24 initial indices for the half-turn. The row calculation uses an independent 8-state transfer, while the older column formula is matched. Direct enumeration of all extendible faces for n=2,3,4 (495,12375,309480 faces) independently agrees. The external theorem arXiv:2611.18058v1 establishes the single reduced rational homology degree and Fibonacci rank; character idempotents and rational equivariant subdivision imply the quotient formula. The all-order claim relies on the recurrence proof, not finite extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Existing same-family single-axis formulas already imply r_n and c_n, so neither is attributed to this finding. Their values plus rank fail to determine the product action: for n=4 rank=2 with r=c=0 admits half-turn trace +2 or -2. The new h_n is independently proved for all n. Full V4 multiplicities and full-group quotient rank are newly determined, not mere renamings of individual quotients. The motivating paper provides ordinary homotopy only; prior ordinary matching-complex half-turn results use a strictly different simplicial complex. Searched relevant published-finding corpus aliases and inspected primary preprint. Residual unindexed novelty risk remains.

value.rationale: A canonical order-four geometric symmetry is present on all rectangular strips, but its half-turn trace is not determined by individual mirror characters. A Fibonacci, unbounded all-order product-character formula completes the irreducible rational V4 module classification and exact homology of the actual symmetry quotient, a natural invariant distinguishing simultaneous from separate reflections. This is structurally motivated, not a routine special case or a single small numerical gain.
